summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, furnishing a press release disclosing its share capital and voting rights as of July 31, 2026, under French regulations (Article L.233-8 II of the French Commercial Code and Article 223-16 of the AMF General Regulation). The report states 50,833,462 shares outstanding, 54,534,179 theoretical voting rights, and 54,512,061 exercisable voting rights. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of voting rights and capital, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is involved; the filing is purely informational and procedural.
